target.description: Original scientific target is the relationship of local synaptic coactivity and dendrite-coincident activity to subsequent spine structural plasticity in apical versus basal dendrites, including compartment-specific Kir manipulations; the bounded legacy component reconstructs four pooled correlations.

dataset.description: Wright et al. processed data/code archive at Zenodo 15047046; equivalence of the currently selected release to manuscript-linked release and detailed source-row provenance remains unresolved.

cohort.description: Figures 2–3 early-training population: apical 375 classified spines in 19 dendrites/10 mice and basal 366 spines in 17 dendrites/12 mice. These nested counts are biological samples, not independently held-out prediction cases.

split.description: The selected paper panels report associations across the observed early-training population, not a training/validation/test prediction split. Creating a held-out-mouse split would define a new extension.

inputs.description: Observed local coactivity, dendrite-coincident activity and baseline/follow-up structural spine measurements. The observed structural outcome enters the association calculation and cannot be a candidate predictor in a new forecasting task.

preprocessing.description: Local-neighbor coactivity, compartment inclusion and structural-change definitions are described in the source, but full supplementary-method and release-version equivalence for the processed feature calculations is not resolved by this review.

metric.description: Pearson correlation and inferential comparisons describe the biological association. There is no defensible direction in which altering a true correlation, a plasticity effect, or its p value constitutes better task performance.

aggregation.description: Paper panels pool spine observations and report compartment-specific summaries; spines are nested in dendrites and mice. This is an association estimand, not an aggregate model-accuracy ranking.

full_panel.description: Source Figure 2–3 local/coincident activity–structural-plasticity findings and Figure 4 Kir/control plasticity result during motor learning, with indispensable source controls and Figure 1 experimental/measurement context; no automatic all18/294 or whole-paper requirement. Retain every source compartment, original plasticity class, early-training role, required original group and weak/null finding for local coactivity, spatial/chance/nearby-stable controls, coincidence and onset timing, and the four apical/basal control/Kir groups. Figure 4 uses original within-compartment comparisons and dendrite-level plasticity fractions with source denominators, not a fabricated compartment-by-Kir interaction. Preserve structural-measure EM validity, dendritic-calcium/somatic-output proxy validity, relevant Figure 1/S3 measurement quality and activity-rate normalization, early-training selection and relevant S6/S8/S9 spatial/coincidence controls, Kir suppression efficacy, homeostatic/state controls and the distance-to-soma explanation check. The six indexed families below give real recovered source quantities; they do not resolve complete original companion selection, all inference tables or publication-version equivalence. Source-defined numerical/statistical and granular obligations without an exact selected-output mapping remain explicit blockers, not scalar placeholders or waived requirements. The four-correlation component remains partial evidence. The accepted full18 released-source component retains its own complete18-family/294-call obligations and source-error gate if separately invoked, but it does not define primary success. Separate control/Kir behavioral trajectories establish learning/task context, not an authenticated between-group learning effect. No automatic movement-encoding, retrospective S7, every-session, both-S5-strata or whole-paper numerical obligation is enrolled. No direct compartment difference follows from differing significance.

permitted_observations.description: Use the original processed-release observations, source time/session roles and authentic complete populations required by the adopted Figure2–3/Figure4 primary and its indispensable controls. Structural outcomes are observed operands of retrospective association, not predictor leakage in a newly invented forecast. Preserve original longitudinal mouse/FOV/session/dendrite/spine ownership, eligible/class masks, original dendrite denominators, complete proxy/Kir populations and worksheet-based distance support. Contextual behavior and additional released branches remain associated source evidence, not automatic primary inputs or new behavioral contrasts.
